scope: Frozen final context-v2 source/label/split/runtime audit, offline only
arguments: You are an independent source-grounded red-team reviewer. Use no tools. Output the requested JSON only.

findings.title: Readback reference rule rejects every valid fixture, offer rule uses different semantics, and controls bind the snapshot to itself
findings.claim: The readback path requires readback.state_revision == snapshot.state_revision. A readback is necessarily spoken at an earlier revision, so the rule rejects legitimate readbacks. All 6 valid train readbacks have revision 3 against snapshot revision 4, and all return stale_binding. The offer path instead uses '>' and defaults a missing state_revision to 0, so offers missing a revision pass. Neither path checks the field that actually defines freshness: whether readback.component_revisions equals the current pending component revisions. Separately, controls and finalize build BindingContext from binding_v2(snapshot). That makes the L240 stale check tautological, so all 180 parity/validate rows prove nothing about binding freshness. check_deferred_refusal_v2 requires an int component_revision, but pending revisions in the data are strings like 'p0:amount:r1', so the function can never return eligible on the real schema.
findings.concrete_counterexample: E-0002 'Yes.' with a valid, completed readback (rev 3, snapshot rev 4) returns stale_binding. A spoken offer dict lacking state_revision returns a reference. A readback whose component_revisions point at superseded p0:date:r1 after the date changed to r2 returns readback_id whenever the revisions are numerically equal.
findings.CPU_witness_contract: W1: E-0002 snapshot with a valid readback rev < snapshot rev and matching component revisions must yield candidate_readback_id. W2: the same input with pending date revision bumped must yield stale_binding. W3: an offer missing state_revision must yield unresolved_reference. W4: BindingContext built from a different authoritative revision than the snapshot must yield neutral stale_binding. Run predict_v2 directly; assert only on reference and abstention fields.
findings.conditional_assumptions: Assumes readbacks are created before the customer turn advances the revision, which matches the authoring generator (rev 3 vs 4).
findings.remedy: Define freshness as follows: component_revisions equal current pending revisions per target, policy_hash is unchanged, readback.spoken_turn_id precedes turn_id, and valid and completed_speech are both True. Require state_revision on offers and reject when it is missing. In controls and tests, source BindingContext from an independent authoritative fixture and include deliberately mismatched cases. Fix the revision type contract in check_deferred_refusal_v2.

findings.title: Lexical candidates fabricate amount evidence from target IDs, times, and dates; the security role takes the whole utterance
findings.claim: The amount regex `\d+` matches card endings, clock digits, and day/year numbers. A single amount match is classified by a completion head with 33/40 'complete' training labels and a polarity head where 'asserted' dominates. The result is a plausible 'complete/asserted amount' component built on a target-identifier span. Under the security role, the pattern `\S(?:.*\S)?` emits the whole turn, including any admin clause, as security_answer evidence. Because '.' excludes newline, multi-line text splits into several candidates and becomes ambiguous. Training only ever saw oracle sub-spans such as 0..4 of '0047, and what is...'. Runtime spans therefore never match the training distribution, and no detection recall is measured anywhere.
findings.concrete_counterexample: 'The card ending 7316 can be paid on Friday.' produces a single amount candidate '7316', labelled complete/asserted, while the gold amount is absent. 'Tomorrow at 21:15, please.' produces amount candidates 21 and 15, plus inconsistent_heads. 'Friday, October 19, 2026.' produces amount candidates 19 and 2026. '0047, and what is this call about?' under the security role produces security_answer = [0,34].
findings.CPU_witness_contract: For these four strings with their train snapshots, assert that no amount component has completion=='complete' and non-empty evidence when the gold amount is absent. Assert that security_answer evidence never covers the span of a co-labelled purpose_question clause. Report candidate recall and false-candidate rate against all oracle spans in train and dev.
findings.conditional_assumptions: The head output for 7316 is not executed here; the claim rests on label priors and the absence of any target-span exclusion.
findings.remedy: Exclude digits adjacent to 'ending'/'last four', to ':', or inside a date expression. Mask whole-turn security spans, or require the shortest digit/date span aligned to security_field. Emit detector_no_candidate separately from ambiguous. Measure detector recall before any head accuracy is reported.

findings.title: Runtime can emit schema-invalid or misleading envelopes that only the offline validator would catch
source_references: design capability rules 'Empty regex candidate list is detector_no_candidate'
findings.claim: The clause_id is turn_id + ':c0'. A turn_id of length 125 to 128 passes the binding check but produces a clause_id over the 128 maximum, and the export performs no schema check. The L291 loop appends every component name, so `any(name=='amount')` is always true and amount_scope is never 'absent'. Components with no candidates are reported as completion 'ambiguous' with an 'untrained_head' reason, which conflates detector absence, untrained heads, and semantic ambiguity. The 'untrained_head' abstention is hardcoded for recipient and allocation even though both have component_support (8 and 2 samples) and get scored whenever they are detected. Under the security role they also receive completion='ambiguous' placeholders.
findings.concrete_counterexample: Any snapshot with a 128-character turn_id produces a clause_id of 131 characters, which fails jsonschema. 'Yes.' in the support phase yields amount_scope 'unresolved' with no amount present.
findings.CPU_witness_contract: Validate the exported runtime output with Draft 2020-12 for turn_id lengths 1, 125, and 128. Assert amount_scope=='absent' when no amount candidate exists. Assert that absent components carry a distinct reason and do not claim completion='ambiguous'.
findings.remedy: Derive clause_id as a bounded hash, or cap turn_id at 124 characters. Compute amount_scope from the raw candidates. Add a capability field outside the wire, or use the existing reason enum consistently. Run a pure builtin structural self-check before return, falling back to neutral runtime_failure.

findings.title: Reported dev gains are mostly baseline-equivalent, and some dev labels are structurally unreachable
findings.claim: The shuffled control (6/22) predicts payment_proposal on nearly every row, which equals the dev majority baseline (6/22). Secondary 21/22 equals always-empty. Polarity 13/15 equals always-asserted. Completion 5/15 equals always-complete. Correction 21/22 is one row above always-none. 'deceased' never appears as a train secondary, so no head exists for it and the single nonempty dev secondary is unreachable by construction. Primary 'unknown' is always masked, so the model can never express 'no identifiable act', and 'purpose_question' has no train positive. Only primary (12/22 vs 6/22 across 20 groups, two of them duplicated) exceeds baseline, at exploratory scale.
findings.concrete_counterexample: E-0165 has gold secondary ['deceased']; the predicted set cannot contain it. E-0154 ('Did you ask whether I confirm...') and E-0173 are predicted readback_affirmation in the readback phase, which is the phase prior, not semantics.
findings.CPU_witness_contract: Recompute every head beside majority, always-empty, and phase-only (phaseâ†’most-frequent-label) baselines, using group-level counts and per-class recall. Assert a model secondary key exists for every dev gold label, or report the row as out-of-ontology.
findings.conditional_assumptions: Uses the frozen metric rows only.
findings.remedy: Build the secondary label set from the frozen ontology, not from train occurrences. Report a phase-prior baseline beside the context model. Mark unrepresentable classes explicitly. Do not cite heads that only match baseline as learned capability.

findings.title: Loss is row-weighted, so one mega-lineage dominates and the context signal is confounded with fixture constants
source_references: authoring make_snapshot L663-L744 (constant pending 137/245, fixed question texts)
findings.claim: Group 74bae451 merges 23 seeds and supplies roughly 30 train rows, many of them amount and date spans. There is no group averaging despite the design loss spec, so this group dominates the completion and polarity heads. The pending/status features are constant ('validated') except in the T05 episodes, and has_offer and has_readback are deterministic functions of the role. 'Context use' therefore amounts to a learned phase prior. The no-context control removes features but is fit by the same row-weighted loss, so the comparison cannot separate semantic context from label priors.
findings.concrete_counterexample: Pair 'Yes.' in the readback phase with a readback that is invalid or superseded: the context features are identical except has_readback, and the label space has no way to express 'stale affirmation'.
findings.CPU_witness_contract: Using fit_v2 offline, refit with per-group averaged loss and report the head deltas. Construct paired snapshots that flip only pending status or offer supersession, and record how much each primary prediction moves.
findings.conditional_assumptions: Requires an owner refit, which was not run here.
findings.remedy: Use group-normalized masked loss as specified in the design. Vary pending, offer, and readback state independently of the role in new data. Add counterfactual-context pairs inside one lineage.

findings.title: Ingress, authentication, and privacy rest entirely on caller-supplied fields
source_references: context_v2.py L108-L111, L144-L145 (security tokens in span:surface features)
findings.claim: The code accepts 'trusted_turn' from the payload and takes the authoritative binding from the same caller. No immutable message ID or ingress attestation is checked. Hash-format regexes accept syntactically valid but forged hashes. Security answers are tokenized into span:surface and suffix features. Digits are delexicalized, but spoken words such as 'nineteen eighty-four' are not, so feature keys are a function of the secret. The OOD decision is always 'unassessed', and unknown phases pass through.
findings.concrete_counterexample: A caller sets source='trusted_turn', any 64-hex hashes, and phase='payment_final_confirm' (unseen). The result is a full proposal, still abstaining, with no ood reason.
findings.CPU_witness_contract: Assert that an unseen phase or question role yields an ood or unknown_schema abstention. Assert that a security-role vector contains no span:surface or suffix keys. Assert that 'trusted_turn' is rejected unless an adapter-attested event ID is present (contract test with a stub attestation).
findings.conditional_assumptions: No platform ingress is specified; the stub is local only.
findings.remedy: Allowlist phase and role enums from the frozen schema. Drop surface features under the security role. Require an attested source-event ID from the adapter, and keep the enum alone non-authoritative.

mathematical_critique.masked_denominators: Head accuracies use different n (primary 22, component 15, target_scope 18). Components without evidence (141 in dev) are excluded, so completion and polarity are conditional on oracle spans. Absent and discontinuous cases never enter the denominators, and 'absent' is never trained despite being a label.
mathematical_critique.baselines: Every head except primary matches a constant predictor. Shuffled primary equals the majority class. A phase-prior baseline is missing and probably explains much of the 12/22.
mathematical_critique.context_ablation: The no-context model removes learned features but evaluation uses oracle spans, so runtime heuristic paths (security span, reference resolution) are untested by any metric. Readback resolution is never exercised successfully (F1).
mathematical_critique.group_independence: There are 20 dev groups for 22 rows, two of them duplicated pairs. There is a single author. Train is dominated by one 23-seed group. There is no group-level loss or CI. 12/22 vs 6/22 on correlated rows is descriptive only.
mathematical_critique.marginal_vs_joint: Primary, secondary, and component outputs are independent marginals. Clauses are collapsed to c0, and multi-clause target_scope is masked. No joint frame or relation graph is scored, so 'correct primary' says nothing about scope, target, or correction linkage.
mathematical_critique.calibration_abstention: Zero accepted outputs means precision and risk are undefined (upper bound 1). Scores are raw softmax outputs at an L2 of 0.0002 and are uncalibrated. Abstention is unconditional, so no selective metric exists.

architecture_recommendations: Replace revision equality with per-component revision matching plus speech ordering for readback and offer references, and require explicit revisions.
Introduce a span detector stage with measured recall. Exclude target IDs and time/date digits from amount candidates, and use field-aligned security spans.
Split per-head capability states (not_implemented, untrained, detector_no_candidate, ambiguous) into bundle diagnostics. Never emit placeholder 'ambiguous' for absence.
Build ontology-complete secondary heads. Allow masked 'unknown' through an explicit no-identifiable-act gate driven by role=='none' rather than learned.
Use group-averaged masked loss, and add phase-prior and counterfactual-context controls before claiming context utility.
Run a builtin structural self-check in the runtime with neutral fallback, and bound clause_id length.
Allowlist phase and role values, add an OOD veto for unseen context values, and remove secret-derived feature keys.

interface_assessment.context_use: Context enters as phase, role, and offer/readback flags crossed with the first 16 tokens. Pending features are near-constant in the data. Effective use is a phase prior; reference heuristics are rule-based and the readback branch never resolves on the fixtures.
interface_assessment.unsupported_heads: Correction and target_scope are trained but not wired to the output. Clause, target, consent, recipient, and allocation abstain. Recipient and allocation components are still scored when detected while being labelled untrained_head (inconsistent).
interface_assessment.stale_binding: The binding equality is tautological in all evaluation paths. Readback freshness is wrong-sign (F1). Policy/API hash content is not verified, only its format.
interface_assessment.ingress_authentication: None. Both the source enum and the binding are caller-supplied. BindingContext immutability is not authentication.
interface_assessment.privacy_permission: No permission fields are emitted, and consent is always descriptive/ambiguous. Security-answer words leak into feature keys, and the whole-turn security span over-captures co-located admin text.
interface_assessment.side_effects: Pure as written. No I/O in the runtime. The parity harness patched open, socket, and Popen offline only.
interface_assessment.runtime_cost: 298,186-byte source with 24,192 dense coefficients decoded into dicts at load (about 70 ms locally, not a hosted guarantee). Per-call cost is roughly linear in feature count times labels and is bounded by 4096 characters and 16 candidates.

limitations: This is a source-only review and nothing was executed. Head outputs for counterexamples (e.g. 7316) are inferred from label priors.
Weights were omitted, so coefficient-level claims are not made.
The labels are single-author synthetic proposals, not gold. The Zeno annotation was not used.
No-context and shuffled controls are owner fits that were not rerun here.
Findings bind to the stated hashes. Later designer, data, or source drift is not covered.
No generalization, safety, or readiness claim follows from 158/22 toy diagnostics.

independent_claim_dispositions.assessment: Supported reference/interface gap; urgency applies before adoption, not an observed write exploit
independent_claim_dispositions.qualification: The existing strict readback global-revision equality is conservative. Older spoken revision is not universally wrong; frozen fixtures and desired component freshness need an explicit compatible revision contract. Removing equality alone would weaken safety. The forced readback-reference census contains 21 valid/completed train contexts, not six actual affirmative examples. Matching global revisions permits descriptive reference despite mismatching component revisions; every output still abstains. Opaque per-component revisions cannot directly feed the deferred-refusal helper integer/top-level contract without an explicit adapter. Independently mismatched authoritative bindings DO return neutral stale_binding.

independent_claim_dispositions.assessment: Independently confirmed diagnostic false evidence and oracle/runtime span mismatch
independent_claim_dispositions.qualification: Card ending 7316 becomes complete/asserted amount; twenty-seventh produces complete/asserted amount span twenty; time/date digits produce competing amount candidates. Security plus purpose captures the entire turn. These are abstaining proposals, not canonical values, identity verification, or actual bank actions. Exact observed-span detection is 75/129 train and 2/15 dev; overlap 102/129 and 6/15. No absent-span false-positive gold denominator is supplied; four synthetic false-candidate contracts are explicit diagnostics.

independent_claim_dispositions.assessment: Schema boundary confirmed; placeholder semantics need separate capability diagnostics
independent_claim_dispositions.qualification: 125-character turn ID plus :c0 has length128 and PASSES; source failure begins126..128. At128 the clause/abstention IDs violate maxLength while status remains abstain. Zero amount candidates still yield amount_scope unresolved because the six placeholder components always include amount. No detection is not proof of semantic absence. Recipient/allocation support samples exist, but actual candidate generator has no path emitting those names; Opus hypothetical scoring when detected is not demonstrated runtime behavior.

independent_claim_dispositions.assessment: Baseline/ontology critique mostly supported, two blanket claims corrected
independent_claim_dispositions.qualification: Projected empty secondary baseline21/22, asserted polarity13/15, complete completion5/15 match learner. Correction21/22 exceeds none20/22 by one. Target_scope14/18 exceeds constant7/18 and primary12/22 exceeds constant6/22 and train-derived phase-only9/22. Thus every non-primary head equals baseline is FALSE. Target/correction scores remain unwired to accepted relations. Only5/22 have all their variable observed marginal rows correct, not full-frame joint accuracy. Deceased secondary is absent from trained secondary heads. Train unknown-primary mask/absent spans and undercovered heads limit diagnostics.

independent_claim_dispositions.assessment: Row/group imbalance and context confounding supported; proposed refit deliberately not executed
independent_claim_dispositions.qualification: Largest train lineage has29/158 records and45/129 samples for each component head. Loss balances heads but not lineage groups. Model genuinely changes Yes predictions under phase/question context, with nonzero context coefficients; improvement over phase-only9/22 is three rows, not proof all gain is phase prior. Conditional validity/supersession tests preserve primary because those flags/revisions are outside its feature projection; reference checks are separate. No train/dev lineage or normalized-text overlaps and no token carrier match >=.72 found; same author/synthetic source and unreviewed labels still prevent an IID/source-independence claim.

independent_claim_dispositions.assessment: External authentication/privacy/OOD dependencies confirmed as unqualified
independent_claim_dispositions.qualification: Caller source enum and equal syntactically valid binding hashes do not authenticate ingress. call_local_id is neither compared in BindingContext nor used in features; external authoritative call/question ownership remains required. Unknown context emits full abstaining diagnostics with OOD unassessed. Missing authoritative binding raises InputRejected before the predictor neutral boundary, requiring an external exception policy. Sensitive spoken words may enter transient feature keys; fixtures here are fictional and no runtime persistence/transmission or privacy permission is shown. Current embedded weights are immutable and exactly verified; a generic dict model_id string alone is not a weight-integrity attestation.

supported_next_remedies.action: Define and enforce independently sourced call/current-turn/question binding and exception policy. Keep authentication, verified identity, privacy and financial consent as separate deterministic dependencies; no caller enum/hash can grant them.

Resolve global versus component revision semantics for readback/offer/refusal. Require well-formed actually spoken references and current target/component revisions. Keep conservative abstention until this contract is frozen; do not simply loosen equality.

Measure detector recall/precision and then detector-plus-classifier joint correctness. Add scoped span proposals that distinguish target IDs/date/time digits from amounts and security value from an administrative aside. Preserve competing/correction spans as unresolved diagnostics; no last-row authority.

Adjudicate new versioned TRAIN labels for linguistic expression completion versus act completion versus deterministic unique-date resolution. Retain frozen final baseline; independently review rare negation/conditional/unfinished/unknown/secondary classes and span relations. Group-normalize loss only in a separately authorized experiment.

Enforce output structural bounds at export boundary; keep clause IDs <=128 for all accepted input IDs. Track capability, detector-no-candidate, semantic ambiguity and unannotated labels separately without inferring absence or permission.

Keep phase-only/constant, mask, group and span detection baselines beside marginal accuracies. Target/correction/consent/frame dependencies need joint evidence; marginal softmax is not joint calibrated probability. All-abstain precision/risk remain undefined and coverage0; freeze independent future calibration/risk/confirmation only after the necessary data review.

Qualify real authenticated raw ingress, code-node time/memory/serialization and fixed-LLM/local-inference eligibility separately on the actual platform. No hosted or GPU action was performed in this review.
